paragraphs.text: The Great Hall of the Biblioplex is the main floor and largest open space within the Biblioplex , located in the Central Campus of Strixhaven in the Northwestern Region of Orrithia on the plane of Arcavios . It serves as the central hub of activity in the building and a primary gathering place for the university's students and faculty.

From its grand main entrance to its interconnected halls, gardens, and study spaces, the Great Hall provides access to many of the institution's most important facilities, including lecture halls, archives, and communal areas. It is both a center of academic life and social interaction, housing everything from the bustling Biblioplex Café and student services to the tranquil Book Gardens and the awe-inspiring Hall of Oracles at its core, where the luminous Strixhaven Snarl radiates magical power throughout the campus.

The Amphitheater (B13) - this grand stage serves multiple purposes — hosting lectures, assemblies, and acting as a central gathering point during emergencies. Magical steps rise from the library floor to the stage, allowing easy access. When the Rose Stage on Silverquill 's campus is unavailable, the Playactors Drama Guild frequently rehearses here.

The Biblioplex Café (B6) — one wall of this space features a mural formed from the roots of a living tree, which occasionally shift and rustle, giving the entire area a sense of subtle vitality. The ceiling is painted with a canopy of leaves that change colors with the seasons, thanks to a permanent illusion spell. The same enchantment animates painted squirrels darting along the root mural and birds fluttering and chirping among the painted foliage. Up to ten students can usually be found here during the day. While three students are normally employed at the café, during orientation, its manager — Aisla Fitzbottom — handles the space alone. Cheerfully energetic and quick to remember faces, Aisla is well-loved, though her organizational system leaves something to be desired. The café always offers fresh coffee and tea, and the sandwich of the day rotates, with exotic variants like toasted cockatrice gizzards on rye, or crunchy frog legs on toast.

The Biblioplex Lounge (B2) — this spacious lounge just past the Main Entrance is furnished with plush couches and sturdy tables, providing a comfortable retreat for students, staff, and employees taking breaks from the student store, the Biblioplex café, or other parts of the library. Each table is scattered with stacks of magazines, newsletters, flyers, and nonmagical scrolls gathered from across campus.

The Book Gardens (B9) - these two peaceful, grassy spaces are nestled among vibrant, magical plant life, where students often sit to read or study in quiet. One year, three awakened shrubs wandered into the gardens and decided to stay — an arrangement the university has gladly embraced. Witherbloom College students typically care for the gardens, and three Witherbloom pledgemages are usually present during the day. Members of the Fantastical Horticulture Club frequently gather here to unwind or hold informal meetings.

The Hall of Oracles (B11) — an awe-inspiring and hallowed chamber at the very center of the Biblioplex, the Central Campus , and Strixhaven itself, lined with monuments along the wall. This is where the first-day orientation for new students is held. The hall was ruined in the Oriq Attack on Strixhaven . The Strixhaven Snarl — a massive, luminous tangle of pure mana and power that illuminates the Hall of Oracles like a magical sun.

Information Desks (B4) — both of these circular desks are staffed by three reference librarians appointed by the faculty. These individuals are not only accomplished scholars but also have great skill with magic. They offer clear and accurate guidance on how to locate any public area or collection within the Biblioplex.

The Lecture Halls (B7) — these four spacious chambers are used for interdisciplinary lectures open to all Strixhaven students. Seating within each hall is magically adjustable, ensuring a comfortable fit for students of all sizes and body types. Enchanted acoustics amplify the instructor's voice while dampening background chatter, creating an ideal learning environment. During class hours, each hall typically hosts one professor and up to thirty students. The Hall of Semantics — A specialized academic hall featured in campus lore and storytelling, home to classes that explore the nature and power of language.

The Main Entrance (B1) — a short flight of enchanted marble steps rises to a modest plaza before the entrance to the Biblioplex. The double doors feature vertical handles sculpted to resemble robed scholars. By day, the doors remain open to all. At night, they are shut, locked, and secured with an arcane lock spell. Only select faculty and the Biblioplex's reference librarians are privy to the lock's password.

The Main Stacks (B10) - Tall bookshelves stretch from floor to ceiling throughout the central and eastern sections of the library's first floor. The eastern stacks, denser and more labyrinthine, are enchanted to shift gently aside as students approach, creating just enough room for a single person to pass between them. These shelves primarily hold introductory-level texts, making them a common destination for first-year students following their instructors' guidance. In both areas, two cogwork archivists tirelessly sort and re-shelve returned or misplaced volumes.

The Student Activities Center (B14) - this versatile space is equipped with tables and chairs and is available for use by any officially recognized student organization at Strixhaven . Groups may use it for meetings, rehearsals, crafting projects, or other approved activities. Tables are lined with flyers from various student organizations, accompanied by a member of each of these organizations.

The Student and Alumni Art Gallery (B12) - This bright, polished gallery is lined with white walls and soaring columns, each adorned with or incorporating artworks in a range of media. Students from Prismari College frequently maintain the space, and three Prismari pledgemages are usually present, either tidying the gallery or studying the displayed pieces to better understand their techniques. A storage room in the back contains supplies and works awaiting exhibition. The Distinguished Society of Fine Artists often gathers here for meetings and critiques.

The Student Council Hall (B15) - furnished with wooden tables and benches, this room features a flag bearing the Strixhaven star symbol hanging on the back wall. It serves as the venue where the student council holds public debates on policies that impact the student body most directly. Leaders of the university's Extracurricular groups regularly visit the council to conduct official business, which typically convenes on the first day of each month. When not in session, the room is either used for other formal university functions or remains unoccupied.

The Student Store (B5) — this compact shop just past the Biblioplex Lounge carries a wide range of books, tools, and supplies essential for academic life. The store is managed by Groff Lundquist , a friendly human commoner and Strixhaven staff member renowned for his flair in coordinating stylish combinations of university apparel. Students can browse and purchase hats, scarves, tunics, robes, gloves, and other clothing items embroidered with either the Strixhaven star or the emblem of one of the five colleges. In addition to standard supplies and clothing, the store also stocks magical items.

Study Areas (B8) - These two open spaces outside the Lecture Halls are furnished with plain wooden tables and chairs, offering students a quiet place to work throughout the day. It's common to see up to thirty students studying here during peak hours.
